turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about worksheets and workbooks.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: They're both part of Excel. You click on tabs and stuff.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you explain how formulas work?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You type a formula and Excel calculates it. SUM adds things. You can also do averages and other functions. It is easy once you practise.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What about references — relative and absolute?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: References are how you point to cells. There are relative ones and absolute ones. The dollar sign is used for one of them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you create a chart?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You select data and insert a chart. You can pick different types. Charts are useful for showing data visually.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Tables organise data. You can sort and filter columns. Filtering shows some rows and hides others.
